unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local packet contains figure images but no data supplement or table with exact per-dose y-values/error bars for the growth and HIV comparison curves. Textual values and qualitative claims were extracted; unreported plot-point exact values were not digitized or fabricated.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Final activity rows preserve source-supported text values, concentration thresholds, qualitative comparisons, and figure locators. Exact graph y-values remain unavailable as nonblocking source-scope cautions.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The 2020 paper cites previous low-toxicity studies but does not report new host-cell toxicity, hemolysis, or cytotoxicity measurements. Exact DRAMP cytotoxicity values are tied to PMID 26026377 and are not promoted as current-paper primary rows.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Toxicity_records remains empty with a caution; database-only prior toxicity annotations are preserved in worker-4 conflict context.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The PMC/landed material reports no supplementary assets; the OA package contains NXML, PDF, and seven figure images only.
